stage: Exploratory instrumentation of already-completed replication data, not a new independent sample

plan.stage: Exploratory instrumentation of already-completed replication data, not a new independent sample
plan.demand_seeds: Use all 30 planned demand seeds from the replication
plan.policies: age_order_eta once and redispatch_eta for all five saved order seeds
plan.question: Is the upper-floor age-order waiting increase concentrated before the first actual service stop or in re-waiting after that stop?
outcomes: Passenger exposure to hall-call reassignment while waiting
Proportion rejected at least once at an actual service stop
plan.matching: Exact same passenger IDs and demands across policies. Neutral order replicates averaged within demand seed before inference
plan.verification: Every instrumented run must exactly reproduce its previously saved outcome metrics
plan.illustration_selection: Use the demand seed nearest to the median saved run-level P95 difference. Use the first saved neutral order seed for its concrete route replay; the illustrated route is not the five-order average
plan.limitations: First service stop includes rejection or boarding but not full-car bypass. Waiting components describe temporal location of burden and do not alone identify a causal routing mechanism

inference: 30 paired demand runs; five neutral orders averaged first; unadjusted exploratory 95% bootstrap
